title: C4 quantitative-claim extraction file (per mine document)
description: One file per hand-written mine document, produced by the Phase 3 extraction fleet (planning/audit-charter.md § 7 Phase 3; instrument: reports/verification/apparatus/c4-extraction-instructions.md). Each claim is a verbatim contiguous span containing one or more numeric values, with a proposed anchor to the least-writable artefact that can verify it (charter § 5 rule 1). Claim ids are assigned at assembly, not extraction. The recompute harness consumes these files and emits the diff report that generate_c4_ledger.py turns into ledger rows.

source_document.description: The mine document swept, pinned by git blob so line-anchor drift is detectable.

claim_id.description: Assigned at assembly (c4-NNNN); null at extraction.

source.description: Locator into the mine document. Lines are 1-indexed and inclusive; the verbatim claim_text must appear within them.

claim_text.description: VERBATIM contiguous span from the source document — never paraphrase, never stitch. The minimal span (sentence, list item, or table row) that carries the numeric claim(s) and enough context to identify what they measure.

values.description: Every checkable numeric value inside the span, in order of appearance.

quantity.description: What the number measures, normalised (e.g. 'F1@20m, condition verified-adv-text-high', 'tile count, Era 2', 'cost USD, min6 55-map production').

path.description: Per-value JSONPath into anchor.file, for multi-value spans (table rows) where the claim-level anchor.path cannot cover every value. Null = use anchor.path.

method.description: Per-value method override for mixed spans (e.g. a delta beside a permutation p). Null = use the claim-level method.

anchor.description: Proposed verification anchor: the least-writable committed artefact whose contents decide the claim. Null only with method 'anchor-unknown', 'historical', 'unverifiable-era', or 'external'.

path.description: JSONPath-ish locator into the anchor for 'read' claims (e.g. $.results['20m'].f1); null when the anchor is a whole artefact (GeoJSON feature count) or the method is not 'read'.

expression.description: For method 'arithmetic': the expression over named operands that reproduces the claim (e.g. 'a - b', '100 * a / b'). Operand names must all appear in operands[].

operands.description: For method 'arithmetic': the named operands the expression consumes, each anchored mechanically.

method.description: read = value sits in a committed artefact at anchor.path; arithmetic = derivable from committed values via anchor.expression; recompute-script = needs scripted recomputation (bootstrap/permutation — record, do not run at extraction); regen-diff = covered by generated-stratum re-derivation; historical = quoted historical value (changelog 'was X' side) — not a live claim; unverifiable-era = retest-era token claim per the per-era verifiability map (flag, don't fight); external = vendor/billing figure outside the repo (attestation only); anchor-unknown = extractor could not locate an anchor — harness/triage resolves.
